heroSubtitle: Connect directly with sellers near you. Buy simply, sell confidently.

aboutIntro: Delala is a local digital marketplace connecting buyers and sellers across Ethiopia directly.
aboutFeatureOneBody: Browse cars, homes, and everyday products in Addis Ababa and across Ethiopia.
aboutFeatureTwoBody: Buyers review a listing and contact the seller directly by phone.
aboutFeatureThreeBody: Seller product requests are reviewed by our team before being published publicly.
servicesTitle: A simpler path for buyers and sellers
servicesIntro: Find products, contact sellers directly, or submit an item to Delala for review.
serviceFeatureOneBody: Filter listings by category, price, and location to find the right match.
serviceFeatureTwoBody: Review the listing and use the seller's phone number to contact them directly.
serviceFeatureThreeBody: Send the product name, description, price, and photos to Delala on Telegram. An admin reviews it before publication.
visionIntro: We are creating an organized marketplace where people can find what they need and sellers can reach the right buyers.
visionFeatureOneBody: Clear product details, responsible review, and direct communication.
visionFeatureTwoBody: Fast search and a mobile-first experience designed for everyday use.
visionFeatureThreeBody: Connecting local businesses with new buyers across Ethiopia.
opportunitiesIntro: Are you a seller, business partner, or service provider? Share your offer with our team.
opportunityFeatureOneBody: Send product details and photos to our Telegram team. Approved products are shown to buyers.
opportunityFeatureTwoBody: Connect local sellers, car dealers, and property agents with our marketplace.
opportunityFeatureThreeBody: Tell us what service you offer and which areas you cover.
